title: Read the Relevant Part of the Graph
text: Compare the values approached from the left and right of $$x=6$$.\n##figure2.gif##

title: Identify the Requested Value
text: Is the statement lim_x->6 $$f(x)=5$$ true or false?

title: State the Result
text: The left-hand limit is $$2$$ and the right-hand limit is $$5$$. Because they differ, lim_x->6 f(x) does not exist.\n##figure3.gif##
